name: Wolf Metals
old_description: Wolf Metals has been at the forefront of custom metal fabrication in Ohio for over three decades. Founded in 1974 by Jim and Mike Wolf, our family-owned company has grown from a small local shop to a leading metal fabrication expert serving industries across the United States.
about:
Wolf Metals operates from Columbus, Ohio, where it was founded in 1974 by Jim and Mike Wolf. The family-owned business began as a small local shop and has grown into a custom metal fabrication specialist serving customers nationwide.

The company provides a full range of fabrication services including laser cutting, water jet cutting, forming, shearing, MIG and TIG welding, fastener insertion, powder coating, plating, assembly, CNC machining, leveling, tube laser cutting, laser welding, and aluminum composite material (ACM) panel fabrication. Its 100,000-square-foot facility houses more than 50 state-of-the-art machines, enabling production runs from single prototypes to high-volume orders.

Wolf Metals serves the automotive, aerospace, defense, energy, medical, agriculture, construction, and industrial machinery sectors. A recent project involved engineering a modular aluminum exoskeleton for DTi Creative to transform John Deere Gators into performance vehicles for marching bands.

The company emphasizes uncompromising quality, continuous innovation, customer focus, integrity, and teamwork as core values. It promotes end-to-end solutions under one roof, backed by a 99.8% on-time delivery rate and a defect rate below 0.1%.
